items.title: 67619_Big Nick Nicholas oral history interview
items.q: that's when I got to play for Bill Robinson

ctx.x: job in New York City...that union thing. But we had a little money. And so I waited that out and then, you know, I went into the Zanzibar, a new Zanzibar, it was across the street from the old Zanzibar, with Claude Hopkins and George James who used to be with Louis Armstrong in 1928, a very fine lead alto player. He got me the job and that's when I got to play for Bill Robinson and so many people and that was Nat King Cole's first New York engagement with his trio.
Was it with the Claude Hopkins... I mean was he billed with them?
